a: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
m: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
